detached_structure.evidence: A separate gray-roofed building sits to the southeast of the central house, close to the lot edge. It may belong to the neighboring lot or be a detached garage or outbuilding.

signals.notes: The central house has a complex gray-shingled roof with a reddish-pink section on the east side, and dense mature trees surround the lot and shade much of the yard; the roof shows some staining and uneven tone.
